name: EuroAlternative

sources.title: EuroAlternative — live directory of European alternatives to big-tech products; 'Submit' nav link; listings tagged by EU country + what they replace; 'Advertise' link; built with Dirstarter

requirements: European digital services only — companies must be European (each listing shows the EU country flag)
'Submit' route in the nav; 'Advertise' for paid placements
Directory format: product card + which big-tech product it's an alternative to
Collections exist: DeGoogle, GDPR Compliant, Open Source, Sovereign Cloud
preparation: Which big-tech product you replace — that's the listing frame
workflow: Use the Submit link on euroalternative.co
Provide product details + country + the alternative-you-replace mapping
watchFor: Hard geographic constraint — EU/European companies only
Sovereignty/privacy framing — generic SaaS without that angle is off-beat
countsAsLive: A listing card on euroalternative.co linking to the product
unknowns: Whether submit is free vs paid (Advertise exists for paid)
